title: cephaelis glabra
intro: Cephaelis glabra, commonly known as Ipecacuanha, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in the tropical regions of Brazil and Peru. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cephaelis glabra include stimulating the respiratory system and increasing the production of mucus, which helps to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, specifically emetine and cephaeline, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
